query: How many days of PTO do employees get, and which document says so?
probe: citation pressure — answer is easy, sourcing is the test
response:
Acme uses a flexible (unlimited) PTO policy—there isn’t a fixed number of PTO days employees “get.”

That said, the policy recommends a minimum of 4 weeks (20 business days) of PTO per year.

Source: “Paid Time Off (PTO) Policy” (pto_policy.md), section “PTO Guidelines” → “Recommended Minimum.”
